6500 lb GVWR in 2026: heavy suv section 179 cap. Section 179 on a sport utility vehicle rated over 6,000 and up to 14,000 lb GVWR is capped at $32,000 for 2026. The 280F passenger automobile caps do not apply, so 100% bonus depreciation can take the rest of the business basis. Maximum first-year deduction on a $80,000 vehicle at 90% business use: $72,000.

This is an estimate, not tax advice. Check Form 4562, its instructions and Pub. 946, or ask a tax professional before you file.

rules: Section 179 on a sport utility vehicle rated over 6,000 and up to 14,000 lb GVWR is capped at $32,000 for 2026. The 280F passenger automobile caps do not apply, so 100% bonus depreciation can take the rest of the business basis.

The SUV cap does not apply to a vehicle that seats more than nine behind the driver, has an open or enclosed cargo area of at least 6 feet not readily reached from the passenger area, or is a cargo van with no seating behind the driver and no body section more than 30 inches ahead of the windshield. Set exempt_from_suv_cap for those.
